title: LifeLink: Blood Bank Inventory
context: Blood units expire. Banks issue the oldest compatible unit first and must find units across centres fast.
input: Units (group, collection day, expiry day) per centre; requests.

milestones.title: Most requested group
milestones.requirement: Requests per blood group id (count array).

milestones.title: Exact volume
milestones.requirement: Count ways to fulfil a request of exactly 800 ml from available bags (backtracking).

milestones.title: Units usable each day
milestones.requirement: Each unit is usable [collection, expiry): difference array.

milestones.title: Units expiring soon
milestones.requirement: Count units expiring in [10, 15) with two lower bounds.
